verdict.rationale: GitHub's ecosystem messaging ('Extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models') implies third-party integrations are possible via Marketplace/webhooks, but the evidence pack never explicitly confirms connecting external CI/CD systems (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI) as an alternative to GitHub Actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook/API-based external CI/CD integration, named third-party CI/CD marketplace apps, and independent confirmation that teams can bypass Actions entirely.
